N_j=2^(j²), c_j=j/N_j, ε_j=N_j^-3 give summable S_p norms for each p>1. Gaussian-weighted L2 seminorms controlled by recursively spaced R_j ensure admissibility and identify T_g with the S_p operator sum. Heat peaks HB_j(0)=2j E(exp(-s))>=2j exp(-2ε_j), Gaussian cross contributions summable by the separation recursion, so Hg(R_j)>=3j/2. Virtanen trace-class heat bound then rules out S1. The uniform-bump numerical surrogate from the package is not proof for the smooth bump; the integration-by-parts identities are. Remaining technical reliance is the cited endpoint theorem and Fock operator identification.
